title: vepris lecomteana
intro: Vepris lecomteana, commonly known as the African yellow myrrh or yellow myrrh tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Vepris lecomteana include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit antiviral and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Vepris lecomteana include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
